entries.c939003137247e25: Building materials used for renovating existing houses. The securities report states that, aided by national government subsidy measures, the Company focused on expanding orders in this field in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The management policy states that in the renovation field, the Company will concentrate on expanding sales to major housing manufacturers. It also states that a construction department was newly established in the fiscal year and that personnel were increased to strengthen the Company's in-house capacity for renovation work.
